ITEM 1 | Scrambled egg pieces, pale yellow with some deeper golden patches, soft and slightly moist, crumbly clusters with small curds about 1-2 cm, spread across most of the plate in a mound roughly 15 cm across and about 2 cm tall at the center, sitting directly on a white square plate | 180

ITEM 2 | Shredded orange cheese, bright orange strands about 3-5 cm long and thin, scattered over the top and through the egg, slightly glossy where it has begun to melt, covering roughly 25% of the egg mound | 40

ITEM 3 | Small reddish-orange flecks, possibly diced pieces about 0.5-1 cm, dispersed among the egg and cheese, slightly moist with a darker tint where they touch the egg, covering a small area near the center and lower left | 15
